description: Average athlete (70kg) — vegetarian dietary preference. Tests solver under food-pool constraint pressure when meat-based foods are excluded.
knownFailureReason: FIXED (bugs #3 + #7): The carb overshoot guard in during-rule-solver.ts now prevents sports drink from adding a minimum serving that would push carbs above carbUpper (1.1x target). This indirectly fixes the sodium gap too: with carbs no longer overshooting, the electrolyte scoring function can add tablets without a carb-overshoot penalty, delivering 700-1050mg sodium within the 15% parity tolerance.
